$Comment: CASUAL preset (partial overlay, decoded via MobScalingSettingsAsset.CODEC). Only the keys that differ from Default; every omitted leaf (and every un-listed leaf inside a partially-filled nested group) falls through to the jar Default via the per-leaf fold. Selected by setting ActivePreset:"Casual" (owner file or /mobscaling preset Casual). Gentler than an even fight: the toughness slope and the damage scale are three quarters of Default's (the damage shape is inherited, so the curve keeps its bend), so a plain mob at a player's own power is a comfortable win rather than a coin flip, and the two rails sit just past a Boss at this preset's own top of the scale (the same rule Default uses, so the rarity ladder keeps its shape). Rarer specials, a narrower group swing, and a distance escalation that starts far out and caps early, so the deep frontier tops out around difficulty 150.
Name: Casual
